spraying: Do not spray during high winds to avoid chemical drift.
Spray during early morning or late afternoon to minimize evaporation.
Always wear protective equipment when mixing and applying chemicals.
re_entry: Observe standard re-entry intervals (usually 12-48 hours) after spraying before re-entering the field without protective gear.
hygiene: Clean farm tools and machinery after working in an infected field.
Remove and destroy heavily diseased plants to prevent further spread.
Practice regular weed control as weeds can harbor pests and diseases.
